changelog: v41 replaces the user-facing alert destination switch with an automatic rule: every alert email ALWAYS goes to support@cytech.biz, and the owner's address is included automatically (same alert letter style as Cytech's copy) as soon as the owner has registered one -- no Cytech/Me/Both selector for the owner to set wrongly anymore, and no SD-card-specific naming since future alerts can cover other problems too. The owner's email field is renamed 'My Email for Alerts' (bare 'My Email' could read as if it were Cytech's own address). This release also carries v40 for units coming from v39 or older: the field label 'My Email for Alerts' (owner types THEIR address; Cytech does not know the final owner), a Register press with an empty field shows 'Enter your email first, then press Register.' and sends nothing; a successful Register sends ONE confirmation mail To: the owner with Cc: support@cytech.biz ('Cytech alert email confirmation: <unit>') so the owner sees it in their own inbox and Cytech still gets the unit<->owner notice; EVERY Register press shows a screen popup ('Cytech alert email') with its status, on top of the inline line under the button; and units with mail configured but no owner registered yet show a small non-blocking hint ('Alert emails are not set up for this system yet -- enter your email in the My Email for Alerts field and press Register with Cytech'). Nothing is lost if the owner never registers: support@cytech.biz always receives every alert.
